summary: Welcome or highlight card at the top of a dashboard: eyebrow, title, description, actions and media, on a brand, accent (gradient) or subtle surface.
whenToUse: Personalized welcome message when the portal opens.
Highlighting something new, an onboarding flow or a priority action on the page.
whenNotToUse: Status messages or errors: use Alert or Banner.
Several highlighted cards on the same screen: one HeroCard per view, otherwise none stands out.

props.name: title
props.description: Title; also provides the accessible name of the region (aria-labelledby).

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: Title heading level, chosen according to the page hierarchy.

props.name: eyebrow
props.description: Short line above the title (date, category, context).

props.name: actions
props.description: Buttons or links; prefer variant="secondary", which keeps its own contrast on every surface.

props.name: media
props.description: Illustration or image: next to the text in wide containers, below it in narrow ones.

props.name: icon
props.description: Decorative icon (aria-hidden) next to the eyebrow.

props.name: variant
props.description: brand: primary surface (gradient in the expressive look); accent: primary→accent gradient in every look; subtle: tonal surface.

inherits: HTML attributes of <section>/<article> (id, style, data-*, aria-*); a passed aria-label or aria-labelledby overrides the default name.
accessibility: Renders a <section> (region named by the title) or an <article>; the title is a real heading at the chosen level.

Text always uses the *-foreground role paired with the surface (action-primary-foreground on brand/accent, action-secondary-foreground on subtle): contrast is guaranteed by the theme, even on gradients and in dark mode.
In forced-colors, gradients are removed and the card gets a system border.
Decorative icons and media: pass alt="" to decorative images, or a meaningful alt.
responsive: Intrinsic layout: the media moves below the text when space runs short (flex-wrap), without breakpoints.
Fluid padding (clamp) and a smaller title below 640px.
commonMistakes: Using Button variant="primary" in the actions on the brand variant: it blends into the surface. Use secondary.
Skipping heading levels: set headingLevel consistently with the page.
Putting essential information only in the media.

examples.name: WithMedia
examples.title: With media
examples.description: The media moves below the text in narrow containers.

limits: Content colors in the actions slot are not adapted to the surface: use components with their own contrast (secondary Button/LinkButton).
Contrast on the accent variant depends on the theme's primary/accent pair: the bundled themes pair foregrounds of equal luminance; custom themes must be checked.
